name: law_firm_software_024_firmwide_referential_integrity_audit
instruction: Run the firm's enabled referential-integrity controls, batched under the episode batch code (ops_meta). Mutate nothing. The firm's control registry (firm_controls) lists the referential controls and which of them are enabled; the integrity policy REF-INTEG-01 defines when a reference counts as a violation -- including which references are intentionally unreferenced scaffolding that is never a violation, and how employee-style fields resolve. Run exactly the enabled referential controls, each against every row of the collection it scopes, and count the rows that fail them. Push one ops_reports row per enabled referential control (report='ref_integrity_control_finding', batch_code) with {control_id, rule_key, scope_collection, violation_count}. STAGE 2 -- push one summary row (report='referential_integrity', batch_code) with {total_violations, by_rule (one entry per enabled control's rule key), clean (true iff total_violations is 0)}, reusing this batch's finding rows per firm policy SEVERITY-01. STAGE 3 -- per SEVERITY-01, push one severity row (report='referential_integrity_severity', batch_code) reusing the summary row's values: worst_rule, worst_rule_count, overall_severity (critical iff total_violations exceeds the episode row's severity_critical_count, else low). No other ops_reports rows for this batch under these report names may exist. Every collection this task doesn't write to must remain untouched.

hazards.mechanism: CTL-REF-07 (grant_reports_award_id) sits in the registry DORMANT with 300 dangling bulk grant_reports behind it in the snapshot (planted: 300, snapshot-confirmed) -- reporting it, or folding its count into total_violations, is a plausible wrong audit that FAILs; only CTL-REF-01..06 are in scope.

REF-INTEG-01's placeholder exemption: references whose string starts with PLACEHOLDER- are intentionally unreferenced scaffolding and are never violations. The snapshot plants 6 PLACEHOLDER- deadlines, 4 PLACEHOLDER- tasks and 3 PLACEHOLDER- time_entries among the dangling rows (planted: 13 placeholder refs, snapshot-confirmed) -- counting them inflates deadlines_matter_id 8->14, tasks_matter_id 6->10 and time_entries_matter_id 7->10, plausible wrong counts that FAIL.

CTL-REF-06 resolves employee-style fields against staff_roster rows ACTIVE at the episode date, not merely present: 4 time_entries reference EMP-606, which is not on the roster at all (planted: 4, snapshot-confirmed; the departed EMP-006 carries zero entries so the active window is latent in this seed but still governs the check).

success_criteria.summary: Exactly one finding row per ENABLED referential control (CTL-REF-01..06) with its by-rule violation count matching both a raw-row pass and a SQL aggregate; the dormant CTL-REF-07 absent; PLACEHOLDER- references exempt (counting them FAILs); one summary row whose by_rule carries exactly the enabled rule keys; one severity row per SEVERITY-01 derived from the summary row's own values and the episode row's severity_critical_count.

checks.expect: one finding row per enabled referential control, one summary row, one severity row; dormant control absent
every by-rule count agrees between the raw-row pass and SQL, and both agree with the pushed rows
counting PLACEHOLDER- references, or reporting the dormant CTL-REF-07, produces wrong counts and FAILs

checks.collections: all seeded collections outside blast_radius (governance collections always canaried)

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: v2 inverts the v1 design: instead of the instruction listing the six rules and asserting a clean sweep, the registry now carries 7 referential controls (one dormant, sitting on 300 dangling bulk rows) and the integrity policy REF-INTEG-01 defines the placeholder exemption and the roster-active resolution -- the agent discovers the scope, the exemption, and the employee rule from data, and the seed plants real dangling rows (8 deadlines, 6 tasks, 7 time_entries, 5 invoices, 4 trust transactions) so the audit is no longer trivially clean.
